title: AWS CloudTrail - Security-Relevant Changes
description: Configuration changes an attacker makes to hide or widen access: logging and detection tampering (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC flow logs, AWS Config), security-group and network-ACL changes, S3 bucket policy, ACL and public-access changes, and KMS key changes.

panels.title: Logging & Detection Tampering
panels.lucene: data_aws_source:cloudtrail AND data_aws_eventName:(StopLogging OR DeleteTrail OR UpdateTrail OR PutEventSelectors OR DeleteDetector OR UpdateDetector OR DisassociateFromMasterAccount OR DeleteFlowLogs OR StopConfigurationRecorder OR DeleteConfigurationRecorder OR DeleteDeliveryChannel)

panels.title: Security Group & NACL Changes
panels.lucene: data_aws_source:cloudtrail AND data_aws_eventName:(AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress OR AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress OR RevokeSecurityGroupIngress OR RevokeSecurityGroupEgress OR CreateSecurityGroup OR DeleteSecurityGroup OR CreateNetworkAclEntry OR ReplaceNetworkAclEntry OR DeleteNetworkAclEntry)

panels.title: S3 Policy & Access Changes
panels.lucene: data_aws_source:cloudtrail AND data_aws_eventName:(PutBucketPolicy OR DeleteBucketPolicy OR PutBucketAcl OR PutObjectAcl OR PutBucketPublicAccessBlock OR DeleteBucketPublicAccessBlock OR PutAccountPublicAccessBlock OR DeleteAccountPublicAccessBlock)

panels.title: KMS Key Changes
panels.lucene: data_aws_source:cloudtrail AND data_aws_eventName:(DisableKey OR ScheduleKeyDeletion OR PutKeyPolicy OR CancelKeyDeletion OR CreateGrant OR RevokeGrant)
